[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} [[Enslavement Stone]]s are carried by the [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]]. It is believed that the Enslavement Stones are what allows the Stone Summit to control the [[Dredge]]. ==Acquisition== *[[Prophecies]] **[[Southern Shiverpeaks]] ***[[Priest of Sorrows]] ***[[Rage Binder]] (only during [[The Forge Heart]]) ***[[Summit Dark Binder]] ***[[Summit Deep Knight]] ***[[Summit Surveyor]] ***[[Summit Taskmaster]] ***[[Summit Warden]] ***[[Gorrel Rockmolder]] ***[[Morgriff Shadestone]] ***[[Thorgall Bludgeonhammer]] ***[[Gargash Thornbeard]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Enslavement Stone#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== To get inside of Sorrow's Furnace, either an [[IMS]] (such as [[Dash]] or alcohol-boosted [[Drunken Master]]) combined with [["I Am Unstoppable!"]] or a speedboosting [[Paragon]] hero is recommended, or even an entire hero team as an escort to be flagged inside of the entrance (which can also help against dredge inside). A fairly standard [[Vow of Silence]] does fairly well with dealing with the dwarves themselves provided some sort of anti-knockdown skill such as [["I Am Unstoppable!"]] is used. The [[Dredge Spirit Caller]]s can also prove a hindrance, as they will use [[Nature's Renewal]] to make Enchantments more difficult to use. ==Collectors== {{:Molenin/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|18th April 2011 and 5th August 2013|Grenth's Footprint|2 [[Enslavement Stone]]s}} ==Notes== *This item shares its model with an [[Elementalist]] [[Skill Gem]] (although this content was never implemented in the released games).
